---
name: Report a GTA VI location
about: Share a sourced in-game reward, job, collectible, bounty or equipment location
title: "GTA VI [item or activity] found in [in-game area]"
---

**Discovery and evidence**

Name the item or job, the in-game district, and what you observed. Link a public gameplay screenshot or guide. Mention the chapter, any prerequisites, and whether the reward depends on the edition.

**Optional GTA VI map position**

Copy the signed **Grid** X and Y from the matching position in Loot Atlas. Use the format `ATLAS_GTA6_GRID=(X,Y)` with one coordinate pair. Leave it out when the location is uncertain.

**Completion steps**

Describe the game prompts or checklist actions that let another player recognize and complete this discovery.
